Three real restaurant excerpts, interpreted from three different design briefs. These are actual selectable PDFs created by the studio's local design engine. Open a PDF to inspect every page, or restore its editable backup in the studio. No AI call or image generation is used.

The local engine interprets a bounded vocabulary and combines four measured print architectures with palettes, motifs and spacing. It is not a runtime language model and does not invent arbitrary layouts. Names and prices remain source snapshots. Source descriptions are paraphrased. User taste acceptance remains pending.
